definitions.explanation: A thick cloud of tiny water droplets near the ground.

examples.japanese: {霧|きり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧。

examples.english: I can't see ahead because of the fog.

examples.japanese: {霧|きり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{晴|は}れて→晴れる：00701_hareru⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えて→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: The fog cleared and the mountains came into view.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{霧|きり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれいだった→きれい：00717_kirei⟧。
⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧{霧|きり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかっている→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: A thin mist hangs over the mountains.
Walking through the mist is a little scary.

notes:
{霧|きり} means fog or mist - tiny water droplets suspended near the ground.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {霧|きり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: fog appears/rolls in
- {霧|きり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{晴|は}れる→晴れる：00701_hareru⟧: fog clears
- {霧|きり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれる→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧: to be enveloped in fog

WEATHER COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{濃霧|のうむ}→濃霧：07378_noumu⟧: dense/thick fog
- ⟦{朝霧|あさぎり}→朝霧：21348_asagiri⟧: morning mist
- ⟦{霧雨|きりさめ}→霧雨：07684_kirisame⟧: drizzle, misty rain

OTHER COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{霧吹|きりふ}き→霧吹き：15171_kirifuki⟧: spray bottle (atomizer)
- ⟦{霧島|きりしま}→霧島：noentry⟧: Kirishima (place name)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
⟦{五里霧中|ごりむちゅう}→五里霧中：05664_gorimuchuu⟧: being completely lost/confused (lit. in fog for five ri)

SIMILAR:
- ⟦もや→靄：06506_moya⟧: haze (lighter than fog)
